diagnosis: Strong 5-star reputation (25 reviews) but completely invisible online—no website means missed calls from homeowners who Google first. SMS is their only contact method.
hero_angle: Perfect Google reviews without the web presence to convert them into consistent leads.
cold_message: Hey Denver Electricians — 25 five-star reviews on Google is legit. But when someone in Denver, CO searches "electrician near me" tonight, they're booking whoever has a website. You're losing jobs to guys with half your reputation. Worth a quick fix? — Dave, Trevo Advisors
